D5/S3/Observer/Tomography/FiniteStageExp.name: D5.S3.Observer.Tomography.FiniteStageExpansion.finite_stage_expansion
D5/S3/Observer/Tomography/FiniteStageExp.signature: theorem finite_stage_expansion (S E : ℕ → ClosedSubmodule ℝ H) (hstep : ∀ k, (S (k + 1)).toSubmodule = (S k).toSubmodule ⊔ (E (k + 1)).toSubmodule) (hshell : ∀ k, (E (k + 1)).toSubmodule ≤ (S k).toSubmoduleᗮ) (n : ℕ) : (S n).toSubmodule = (S 0).toSubmodule ⊔ finiteShellSpan E n ∧ (⊤ : Submodule ℝ H) = (S 0).toSubmodule ⊔ finiteShellSpan E n ⊔ (S n).toSubmoduleᗮ ∧ (S n).toSubmoduleᗮ = (E (n + 1)).toSubmodule ⊔ (S (n + 1)).toSubmoduleᗮ
